name: 311-service-equity
title: Ottawa 311 — what 'days to close' actually measures
description: An attempt to test whether lower-equity neighbourhoods wait longer for city services, which instead established that the published close date is administrative rather than operational for most request categories, and that the ward time-to-close gradient in releases/311-by-ward is a request-mix artifact.
